_comment: Run template for lbnl-ddahu: OA fraction at the mixing box against the unit's SEASONAL design minimum. The sequence (inventory section 1.2(ii)) holds a 28% minimum damper position Jun-Aug and 45% otherwise; measured on the fault-free run (OA_CFM / (CSA_CFM + HSA_CFM) over the occupied, fan-on minutes at those two positions) they give 11.9% and 31.8% OA, and the temperature balance the rule uses agrees (13.6% and 31.8%). A seasonal minimum was chosen over judging measured OA flow against one number: the design itself has two minima, so no single number -- temperature- or flow-based -- is right in both seasons (against 11.9% the healthy winter reads as excess OA; against 31.8% the 45%-stuck run passes). The rule judges fan-on (CSF_CS), operate-mode (SYS_CTL) samples. simultaneous_heat_cool is not run: by design the hot deck heats to 90 F while the cold deck cools to 55 F. leaking_valve is not run (0.98, #84): the mapped supply air is the cold deck (CSA_TEMP), which the hot-deck heating coil never touches, so the default rule judges a heating leak on the wrong air stream. Run on the whole store it false-faults DDAHU__DMPRStuck_OA_0 (a heating-leak signature in 46.8% of both-valves-shut hours, hourly) and declines the fault-free and OA_100 runs (fewer than 10 fan-on hours with both valves shut). With judge_heating_on_supply_air false the heating coil is left unjudged (no hot-deck coil leaving-air point is mapped) and that run reads ok.
